patch_description: Implement the untested Gen 15 idea correctly: for each destination, evaluate up to 6 bounded simple path candidates and score them with a discount for edges already used by previously routed destinations (trunk consolidation). Select the candidate with the best discounted score, but only adopt it if its true (undiscounted) cost is ≤ the Dijkstra baseline cost for that destination — guaranteeing we are never worse than the current 1035.14 baseline, while potentially reducing cost when a slightly longer path shares cheap trunk edges with earlier destinations. The discount alpha is set to 0.3 within the recommended range.
